title: Military coup in Sudan
summary: Sudan's army dissolved the civilian-led transitional government and detained the prime minister, ending a power-sharing arrangement agreed after the 2019 revolution.
body:
On 25 October 2021 the Sudanese military, led by General Abdel Fattah al-Burhan, dissolved the transitional government and detained Prime Minister Abdalla Hamdok and other civilian officials.

The coup ended the power-sharing arrangement between the military and civilian groups agreed after the fall of Omar al-Bashir in 2019, and was followed by months of street protests.

title: War in Sudan
summary: A war between Sudan's army and the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces that began in Khartoum in April 2023 and spread across the country.
body:
Fighting broke out in Khartoum on 15 April 2023 between the Sudanese Armed Forces and the Rapid Support Forces (RSF), former partners who had shared power since the 2021 coup.

The war spread to Darfur, Kordofan and Gezira and displaced millions of people.
